## Context

The project has audience guidance distributed across AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, and individual documents. It lacks one current-state policy that distinguishes durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. The audit ticket minimum-rainy-fawn approved F01 as a documentation policy and catalog relocation. The parent epic washedup-cattish-mealworm assigns the lossless catalog relocation to F01 so F06 can remain a one-file navigation rewrite.

F01 merged through Gerrit change 2022. A later correction removed the writing rules after the operator rejected mechanical character enforcement. The operator clarified that the writing rules remain approved as guidance. The rejected mechanism is mechanical enforcement that produces false positives. F01 must restore the guidance without adding a deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose gate.

## Current enforcement and history

Ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale added generated markers, two contributor tables in docs/README.md, and tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py after repeated changes edited derived outputs instead of their sources. F01 moved both tables to docs/generated-artifacts.md and repointed every existing inventory consumer. The GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED collections remain the enforcement sources for generated and parity-gated artifacts.

No current repository gate validates documentation by character, word, punctuation, paragraph shape, or prose style. F01 does not add one. Existing structural, generated-artifact, link, and comment-hygiene gates retain their current scope.

## Plan

Retain docs/documentation-policy.md as the current policy for tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. Define the audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, use of citations, correction method, exclusions, and examples for each category. State that ticket events remain append-only. State that ADR decision substance is preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs.

Restore the Writing rules and Protected forms text from 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb:docs/documentation-policy.md. Keep its connector, colon, hyphen, paragraph, diction, filler, authenticity-padding, and formal-voice guidance. Add a sentence that labels the rules as authoring guidance. Add a sentence that states the rules do not define a deterministic validator or gate contract. Keep the Protected forms safeguard for licenses, quotations, captures, frozen output, serialized fixtures, technical syntax, wording fixtures, generated outputs, historical ticket events, ADR decision substance, and protected evidence.

Retain docs/generated-artifacts.md as the contributor inventory. Preserve the generated and parity-gated tables that moved from docs/README.md. Restore the pre-F01 descriptions for the docs/cli-reference.md, server.json, criteria_routing.json, and reviewer-prompt rows from 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb^:docs/README.md. Preserve every catalog entry, regeneration command, enforcement gate, and section order.

Keep the relocated inventory consumers in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py. Preserve the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED values. Keep the CONTRIBUTING.md pointer to docs/generated-artifacts.md.

Keep concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md. Describe the destination as the documentation ownership, correction, and writing-guidance policy. Do not describe the guidance as a deterministic gate.

## Exclusions

- No deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validator.
- No new hook, test gate, CI gate, or runtime rejection based on the writing guidance.
- No edits to generated outputs, ADR decision substance, ticket events, historical evidence, protected evidence, or commit history.
- No repository-wide prose rewrite.
- No F05 ownership descriptor, generated catalog generator, or new ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The policy role table covers exactly the eight roles listed in the Plan.
- [ ] Every policy role entry provides every field listed in the Plan.
- [ ] The Writing rules section is present in docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] The Writing rules section identifies itself as authoring guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section states that it does not define a deterministic validator or gate contract.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved connector guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved colon guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved hyphen guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved Markdown paragraph guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved formal-voice guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved diction guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved filler guidance.
- [ ] The Writing rules section contains the approved authenticity-padding guidance.
- [ ] The Protected forms section is present.
- [ ] The Protected forms section lists every protected form named in the Plan.
- [ ] F01 adds no deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validator.
- [ ] F01 adds no hook, test gate, CI gate, or runtime rejection based on the writing guidance.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md retains the approved ownership, lifecycle, canonical-source, citation, correction, generated-artifact, historical-record, exclusion, and example content.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md requires ticket corrections through new append-only events.
- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md requires ADR corrections without erasing decision substance.
- [ ] AGENTS.md points to the documentation ownership, correction, and writing guidance.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md points contributors to ownership, canonical-source selection, correction paths, and writing guidance.
- [ ] docs/README.md identifies the policy as the source for writing guidance.
- [ ] The docs/cli-reference.md catalog description matches 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb^:docs/README.md.
- [ ] The server.json catalog description matches 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb^:docs/README.md.
- [ ] The criteria_routing.json catalog description matches 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb^:docs/README.md.
- [ ] The reviewer-prompt catalog description matches 34086d29d87e2366ec37a702d887e0a51e8014eb^:docs/README.md.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md retains every generated catalog row.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md retains every parity-gated catalog row.
- [ ] The GENERATED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [ ] The GATED_HAND_AUTHORED value in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py is unchanged.
- [ ] Every inventory consumer in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py reads docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] No inventory documentation in tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py identifies docs/README.md as the catalog.
- [ ] The CONTRIBUTING pointer test requires docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] AGENTS.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] docs/README.md links to documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] No maintained file references docs/README.md#generated-artifacts after the move.
- [ ] The targeted marker test passes.
- [ ] make lint passes.
- [ ] make typecheck passes.
- [ ] The project test gate passes.
